mentions.name: Arduboy intro electronics classes
mentions.description: Classes teaching tech newbies how to build their own handheld video game consoles through intro electronics lessons using breadboard Arduboy clones. Class materials are shared with instructors, and the effort is recruiting people to run these classes in their local areas.
mentions.audience: Tech newbies interested in learning electronics by building their own handheld video game console
mentions.source_excerpt: Also trying to recruit people to teach tech newbies how to build their own handheld video game consoles. Let me know if you might like to run a class where you live and i'll share my class materials.
